title: Nita Ambani And Isha Ambani Shine At Bvlgari's Serpenti Infinito Exhibition At NMACC | Fashion News - News18
text: On October 1, the spotlight at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre (NMACC) in Mumbai was on Nita Ambani and Isha Ambani as they attended the Bvlgari Serpenti Infinito exhibition. While the red carpet was filled with elegant gowns, Nita Ambani opted for timeless tradition in a silk saree, and Isha Ambani turned heads in a glamorous couture gown paired with a breathtaking rose gold necklace. Nita Ambani Dazzles in a Handloom Saree For the opening night of the exhibition where she was also seen with Priyanka Chopra, Nita Ambani showcased the perfect fusion of Indian craftsmanship and Italian luxury. She wore a striking black and silver handloom pachrangi saree featuring intricate chevron patterns and a Banarasi gold zari border, sourced from the shelves of Swadesh. To add a vibrant pop of color, she paired the saree with a rani pink silk blouse by Manish Malhotra, draping the pallu elegantly so it trailed to the floor. Completing her look were emerald earrings from her personal collection and the pièce de résistance, a rare Bvlgari Serpenti Rainforest bracelet, embellished with emeralds and diamonds. Isha Ambani Stuns in Rose Gold and Couture Glam If Nita embodied tradition, Isha Ambani delivered high-fashion drama. She wore an Ashi Studio gown with a plunging U-neckline, a corseted bodice, and a voluminous skirt with a sweeping train. She styled her hair in soft, loose waves and opted for fresh glam, blushed cheeks, dewy highlighter, feathered brows, mascara-laden lashes, glossy pink lips, and shimmering pink eyeshadow. But it was her jewellery that stole the show. Isha adorned her look with the exquisite Serpenti Divine Monsoon necklace, crafted in rose gold and set with tanzanites, tourmalines, rubies, and diamonds. Fashion critic Diet Sabya even quipped on Instagram, “Heart of the Ocean, who? Isha’s rose gold necklace needs a movie of its own." Continuing her tradition of wearing heirloom pieces from her mother’s collection, Isha paired the necklace with a vintage yellow diamond Bvlgari ring, a treasure Nita Ambani had acquired in New York over 25 years ago.
